messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty auto-page fired -> p99 latency breach for /v1/generate (eu-west). current p99=1.80s, SLO=1.00s. Incident created INC-2021. Grafana: https://graf.redwood/g/abc123

pagerduty: Incident INC-2021 routed to on-call rotation (primary: Arjun). Auto-escalation enabled.

Arjun: ack'd. I'm on-call and taking lead. Starting quick triage.

Morgan: noted. I'm pulling kvcache/sidecar metrics now, looks like eviction rate spiked ~18:12 UTC and there are a few hot keys from client account cust-42.

Sofia: if hotkeys are spiking, can we temporarily divert traffic for heavy callers to fallback model variant (lower mem, narrower context) and throttle top qps? I can flip routing if @Arjun gives go.

Arjun: go ahead Sofia. I'll also scale the serving pool by +4 and warm sidecars. Running commands:```bash
# scale serving deployment
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serve-eu-west --replicas=12
# route customers with label heavy -> fallback model
rwctl route set --selector customer=cust-42 --model redwood/fallback-medium:2026-02
```

Jamie: warming prefix cache for top 100 prefixes from cust-42, kicking off prefill job. curl snippet:```bash
curl -X POST https://console.prefill/eu-west -d '{"prefixes": ["Hi", "Order status", "Invoice"]}'
```

Morgan: KV eviction rate dropping after prefill start, evictions/s down from 420 -> 60 in last 90s. Hotkey qps still elevated but distribution smoothing.

Arjun: scaled and routed fallback, p95 now ~0.92s, p99 ~1.12s and trending down. No error spike, just high tail latency. Customers with heavy concurrent endpoints (cust-42, cust-77) saw slower responses during the 90s window.

Sofia: good. I'm going to keep routing in place for 15m and monitor. If stable, we'll gradually migrate back. Planning follow-up: create ticket INF-3245 to add per-customer soft caps and KV cache hedging for hotkeys.

Jamie: on handover — I can watch for the next 2 hours and escalate if p99 > 1.3s or error rate > 0.5%. :thumbsup:

Arjun: handing off to Jamie for monitoring. Leaving notes in INC-2021 and opening post-incident checklist. Thanks team.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2021 acknowledged by Arjun at 1787659998, auto-page suppressed.

Morgan: quick customer-impact summary for postmortem: brief slowdown for small subset (2 customers) for ~90s window, no request failures, SLO blips recorded. Recommend KV cache tuning + routing guardrails.

Sofia: filing follow-up RFC for hotkey detection and automatic fallback. I'll add playbook steps for prefill + fallback routing.

Jamie: monitoring clear after 13m, p99 back to 0.98s. Closing out watch, will update INC-2021 and tag Eng-Oncall rotation.

Arjun: thanks all — will assign owners and schedule postmortem next week.
